definitions.mrr: Monthly recurring revenue: sum of recurring subscription revenue expected in a month. One-time revenue is excluded.
definitions.growth: Growth MoM = (this period MRR − prior period MRR) ÷ prior period MRR. Requires two entered monthly MRR values.
definitions.grossBurn: Gross burn is the total cash spent in a month, before subtracting revenue received.
definitions.netBurn: Net burn = gross burn − revenue received. Values at or below zero do not produce a positive runway estimate.
definitions.runway: Runway = latest cash balance ÷ latest positive net burn. It is a simple estimate and does not model future changes.
definitions.cac: CAC = sales and marketing spend ÷ new customers acquired in the same period. Requires both values.
definitions.ltv: LTV = average monthly recurring revenue per active customer × gross margin ÷ monthly customer churn rate. Requires entered inputs and is not a forecast.
definitions.payback: Payback months = CAC ÷ (average monthly recurring revenue per customer × gross margin). Requires entered inputs.
definitions.churn: Customer churn = customers lost during a period ÷ customers at the start of that period.
definitions.nrr: Net revenue retention requires start MRR plus expansion, contraction and churn values. Those inputs are not yet collected here.
definitions.readiness: Readiness score is produced by a verified service using checklist completion, traction and mentor feedback. That service is not connected; no score is shown.
